name: weekly-status-digest
description: Collect weekly wins, risks, and next steps via form, then format a concise Markdown status digest.

steps.description: What were the key wins this week?

inputs.name: wins
inputs.description: Key wins and accomplishments (one per line)

steps.description: What are the current risks or blockers?

inputs.name: risks
inputs.description: Risks, blockers, or concerns (one per line; write 'None' if clear)

steps.description: What are the priorities for next week?

inputs.name: next
inputs.description: Planned priorities for next week (one per line)

steps.description: Format the weekly status digest as a Markdown document.
steps.run:
set -o pipefail; jq -r '
  "## Weekly Status Digest
" +
  "**Team:** " + ((.inputs.team // "Engineering") | tostring) + "
" +
  "**Week:** " + ((.inputs.week // "current") | tostring) + "

" +
  "### Wins

" + ((."collect-wins".wins // "(none reported)") | tostring) + "

" +
  "### Risks & Blockers

" + ((."collect-risks".risks // "None") | tostring) + "

" +
  "### Next Week

" + ((."collect-next".next // "(none reported)") | tostring)
' <<< "$OSL_CONTEXT" | jq -Rs '{weekly_digest: .}'
